reason: R8-P5b (#1524): the break that skips the grid restart once the first bisection found a fitting step. Switched off, the restart runs anyway: it takes the largest fitting grid point and bisects up to the band's upper edge, which the first bisection had already found to the same 0.01 kW-thermal resolution, so every driver in play passes (`python3 tests/mutation_table.py --pin-killed --base origin/fix/r8-p5`, at 9d6bf172, 2026-09-25). A gap rather than equivalent: the two arms can return steps that differ inside that resolution, and the mutant costs up to 32 extra sizing rollouts.
